neighborhoods.name: Upper Halliford
neighborhoods.notes: riverside setting, period locks and latches common

property_mix.era: predominantly Victorian and Edwardian with interwar infill
property_mix.notable: riverside Thames town with strong period property stock; many original timber frames and heritage locks requiring specialist handling

locksmith_relevant: Ashford Common and Sunbury Common contain listed Victorian villas with original period locks—specialists needed for sash windows and cast-iron hardware.
Upper Halliford's riverside cottages feature older wooden doors and traditional mechanisms vulnerable to Thames damp; preventive maintenance is crucial.
Kempton Park's interwar semis often have non-standard door frames; locksmiths should stock varied hinge and latch sizes for efficient call-outs.
